cross_lane_findings.finding: robots.txt captured on 2026-10-09 disallows /api/ on www.openstreetmap.org and api.openstreetmap.org, /api/ on overpass-api.de, and /search, /lookup, /reverse and /details on nominatim.openstreetmap.org. The synthesis reviewer counted 52 evidence rows in the thirty-fifth draft that use those paths (OSM API 26, Overpass 8, Nominatim 18); 31 projects on 31 sites (7 v0.17 baseline, 24 expansion) bind at least one of them as geometry evidence. Robots state at the original capture times was not captured. New round43 locators and cross-checks avoid these paths; frozen rows are unchanged, and any remediation needs its own versioned review.

The admitted Keppel Genting Lane locator was captured from the OSM API on 2026-09-25. It was re-derived from the checksummed Geofabrik Malaysia-Singapore-Brunei extract of 2026-10-08 (MD5 equal to the published baa3da8a57817c27880fee5d436a056b): way 1560974456 version 2, 21 nodes, vertex-for-vertex identical to the admitted geometry (canonical sha256 e19d857640d503f501e6722458ea5f7ee774ce789ebcba77832609462183ee17). The admitted geometry is therefore reproducible from an allowed bulk source; the thirty-fifth rows are not changed.

rights_and_custody: Raw captures stay in ignored tmp/research-round41-*, tmp/research-round42-* and tmp/research-round43-* folders. Only concise restated findings, identifiers and hashes are committed. Personal names, telephone numbers, e-mail addresses, signatures and LinkedIn content are not reproduced.
